scope: Ghana medical discovery — University of Cape Coast Graduate Entry MBChB

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Cape Coast's 2025/26 Graduate Entry MBChB notice describes a full-time residential programme beginning in February 2026 and restricted to first-degree holders.

The 2025/26 call requires a science-related BSc with at least Second Class Honours Lower Division, an entrance examination and a selection interview; it also describes the programme as strictly fee-paying.
The reviewed 2026/27 UCC graduate and first-degree admission notices do not establish an active Graduate Entry MBChB call, its tuition or international applicant route.

holdReasons: No 2026/27 Graduate Entry MBChB announcement was found; the verified programme-specific call is for 2025/26 and has passed.
The available call says fee-paying but does not publish current annual MBChB tuition or a total programme fee.
No current official source was captured for international eligibility, teaching language, programme duration, clinical training or professional recognition.
The route is graduate entry and must not be merged with UCC's separate regular first-degree MBChB listing.
nextAction: Wait for or obtain UCC's next Graduate Entry MBChB notice, fee schedule and curriculum/clinical-language documentation. Package only route-specific evidence for the graduate-entry programme.
